profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the information technology and services industry. Skilled in Applications Software Development, Java, Typescript, SQL, Requirements Analysis. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor’s Degree focused in Computer Science, Minor Mathematics from Virginia Commonwealth University.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
-Perform backend coding in Java/J2EE for large scale federal project
-Perform frontend coding using HTML/TypeScript/CSS/
-Working with Angular, Spring Boot, Oracle SQL, MongoDB
positions.insights: MongoDB, Visual Studio code and +14 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
●	Partook in an agile environment with daily scrum meetings
●	Engaged in client requirement gathering, analysis, and application design processes to ensure alignment with project objectives and client expectations
●	Analyzed business and functional requirements to ensure alignment with project objectives and deliverables
●	Collaborated with cross-functional teams to troubleshoot and resolve issues, ensuring smooth operation of the software systems
●	Participated in JUnit Testing and test case preparation activities
●	Resolved defects identified in both Production and QA environments, utilizing Jira tracking portal for efficient issue management
●	Utilized the JDBC driver to establish connections with the Oracle database for handling all data transactions

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer Science with Mathematics Minor and Certificate in Cybersecurity
